artifact.statement: Returning customers lose unfinished onboarding progress when restarting the flow, leading to redundant steps and frustration.
artifact.mechanism: Implement persistent storage of onboarding progress using local storage to resume exactly where the user left off.
artifact.title: Save Onboarding Progress for Returning Customers
artifact.summary: Stores user progress during onboarding in local storage, allowing resumption of the flow without repeating steps upon return.
